caption: The drawing depicts a three-legged stool shown from different angles and at different scales on an off-white background. The central and largest illustration is a partially colored front view, showing a round seat rendered in brown and labeled "old leather," with gold or yellow dots representing nails or tacks around its edge. The seat is supported by three legs: one leg is colored brown and labeled "this color," while the other two are outlined but uncolored. The seat diameter is marked as 12 inches, and there are additional measurements along the legs. Below this, a smaller side view drawing of the same stool is presented, fully colored in brown tones and similarly labeled for the leather seat. To the right, a top-down architectural-style sketch of the stool is shown at quarter-size with more precise measurements, rendered in pencil without color. Various notes and dimensions are written in cursive and print. The overall composition arranges the three studies of the stool in a triangular layout while keeping the background unadorned, focusing attention on the object.
title: Stool
